request.style: English, deep male baritone solo, slide guitar, upright bass, brushed drums, mournful mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Died with Christ in the tomb
We believe we live with him now
He rose from the dead
Death has no power over him

[Verse]
He died to sin once for all
He lives to God from the fall
Consider yourselves dead to sin
Alive to God in Christ Jesus

[Chorus]
Dead to sin but alive to God
Dead to sin in the mortal body
Alive to God in Christ Jesus
Do not let sin reign in you

[Verse]
Do not obey its evil desires
Do not offer parts as weapons
Offer yourselves to God alone
Alive from the dead to stand

[Chorus]
Dead to sin but alive to God
Dead to sin in the mortal body
Alive to God in Christ Jesus
Do not let sin reign in you

[Bridge]
Offer parts as weapons of righteousness
Sin shall not be your master
Not under law but under grace
You are alive in God

[Chorus]
Dead to sin but alive to God
Dead to sin in the mortal body
Alive to God in Christ Jesus
Do not let sin reign in you

[Outro]
Alive to God in Christ Jesus
Dead to sin
